why: The YFGY is a named, pilot-tested and validated survey instrument for assessing postgraduate transition factors and related academic-performance determinants, not a reusable instructional element.
name: YFGY ('your first graduate year') survey instrument
product_description: A culturally adapted survey instrument developed by Lai Wenyi et al. for Chinese medical postgraduate students, measuring demographic, academic-profile, postgraduate-transition, and self-assessment factors associated with academic performance.
